description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource class for managing accounting closures (GLClosures) in the Fineract system. It includes endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting accounting closure records, with annotations for Swagger documentation and JAX-RS RESTful web services.

classes.name: GLClosuresApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing accounting closures (GLClosures) in the Fineract system.

methods.name: retrieveAllClosures
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all accounting closures, optionally filtered by officeId.

methods.name: retreiveClosure
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific accounting closure by ID, with optional field filtering.

methods.name: createGLClosure
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new accounting closure record.

methods.name: updateGLClosure
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update comments of an existing accounting closure.

methods.name: deleteGLClosure
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove the latest accounting closure for a branch.
